title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 175
paragraphs: After a time the Pedasians were conquered; and the Lykians, when Harpagos marched his army into the plain of Xanthos, came out against him and fought, few against many, and displayed proofs of valor. But being defeated and confined within their city, they gathered together into the citadel their wives, their children, their property, and their servants, and after that they set fire to this citadel, so that it was all in flames. Having done this and sworn terrible oaths with one another, they went forth against the enemy and were slain in battle — that is to say, all the men of Xanthos. Of the Xanthians who now claim to be Lykians, the greater number have come in from abroad, except only eighty households; but these eighty households happened at that time to be away from their native place, and so escaped destruction. Thus Harpagos obtained possession of Xanthos; and he obtained Caunos in like manner, for the men of Caunos imitated in most respects the behavior of the Lykians.
